coverage: WinUI Compatibility Preview adds clear-history, save-baseline, canonical row projection and selection, three validated event fields and add-event action through Vst3TimelineEditorViewModelV1
WinUI Compatibility Preview retains timeline selection/registration/removal, draft begin/commit/discard, undo/redo and selected-row value update
DesktopCompat exposes the complete local timeline workflow with accessible ComboBox, ListBox, TextBox and Button controls
selected-row update and delete use the existing bounded ViewModel methods; no control-model, IPC or persistence changes
accessibility scans cover newly added interactive controls in both previews

limitations: No runtime screen-reader audit, physical audio delivery, driver install/load, HLK or Microsoft signing claim.
